experiment: BirdSet SSW as an alternative baseline training dataset
status: Diagnostic only; excluded from formal baseline selection
task: Eight-output multi-label soundscape classification with sigmoid and binary cross-entropy

external_test.relationship_to_training: Independent dataset; no DB3V recording was used for training or model selection

limitations: BirdSet SSW test_5s is repurposed for development in this diagnostic and therefore cannot simultaneously be treated as an independent BirdSet test.
Setophaga_ruticilla has only two positive clips from one long recording; that recording remains in training and validation has no positive support for this class.
BirdSet internal macro-F1 is a seven-supported-class multi-label metric and is not directly comparable with Xeno-canto or DB3V eight-class single-label macro-F1.
